const DATE_LIMIT_MS = 8640000000000000;
const DAY_MS = 86400000;
const DAY_SECONDS = 86400;
const DEFAULT_LOCALE = "en-US";
const localeNames = Object.freeze({
  en: "en",
  "en-ca": "en-CA",
  "en-us": "en-US",
  "ru-ru": "ru-RU",
});
const englishWeekdays = Object.freeze(["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"]);
const russianWeekdays = Object.freeze(["вс", "пн", "вт", "ср", "чт", "пт", "сб"]);
const dateTimeSlots = new WeakMap();
const numberSlots = new WeakMap();

function modulo(value, divisor) {
  const remainder = value % divisor;
  return remainder < 0 ? remainder + divisor : remainder;
}

function floorDiv(value, divisor) {
  return Math.floor(value / divisor);
}

function civilFromDays(daysSinceEpoch) {
  const shifted = daysSinceEpoch + 719468;
  const era = floorDiv(shifted, 146097);
  const dayOfEra = shifted - era * 146097;
  const yearOfEra = floorDiv(
    dayOfEra - floorDiv(dayOfEra, 1460) + floorDiv(dayOfEra, 36524) - floorDiv(dayOfEra, 146096),
    365
  );
  let year = yearOfEra + era * 400;
  const dayOfYear =
    dayOfEra - (365 * yearOfEra + floorDiv(yearOfEra, 4) - floorDiv(yearOfEra, 100));
  const monthPrime = floorDiv(5 * dayOfYear + 2, 153);
  const day = dayOfYear - floorDiv(153 * monthPrime + 2, 5) + 1;
  const month = monthPrime + (monthPrime < 10 ? 3 : -9);
  if (month <= 2) year += 1;
  return { day, month, year };
}

function daysFromCivil(year, month, day) {
  const adjustedYear = year - (month <= 2 ? 1 : 0);
  const era = floorDiv(adjustedYear, 400);
  const yearOfEra = adjustedYear - era * 400;
  const monthPrime = month + (month > 2 ? -3 : 9);
  const dayOfYear = floorDiv(153 * monthPrime + 2, 5) + day - 1;
  const dayOfEra = yearOfEra * 365 + floorDiv(yearOfEra, 4) - floorDiv(yearOfEra, 100) + dayOfYear;
  return era * 146097 + dayOfEra - 719468;
}

function daysInMonth(year, month) {
  if (month === 2) {
    return modulo(year, 4) === 0 && (modulo(year, 100) !== 0 || modulo(year, 400) === 0) ? 29 : 28;
  }
  return month === 4 || month === 6 || month === 9 || month === 11 ? 30 : 31;
}

function canonicalLocale(locales) {
  let requested;
  if (locales === undefined) return DEFAULT_LOCALE;
  if (typeof locales === "string") {
    requested = [locales];
  } else if (Array.isArray(locales)) {
    requested = locales;
  } else {
    throw new TypeError("Intl locales must be a string or an array of strings");
  }
  if (requested.length === 0) return DEFAULT_LOCALE;
  for (const locale of requested) {
    if (typeof locale !== "string") throw new TypeError("Intl locale entries must be strings");
    const canonical = localeNames[locale.toLowerCase()];
    if (canonical === undefined) {
      throw new RangeError(`Unsupported Intl locale ${JSON.stringify(locale)}`);
    }
  }
  return localeNames[requested[0].toLowerCase()];
}

function optionsObject(options) {
  if (options === undefined) return {};
  if (options === null) throw new TypeError("Intl options cannot be null");
  return Object(options);
}

function rejectPresentOptions(options, names, family) {
  for (const name of names) {
    if (options[name] !== undefined) {
      throw new RangeError(`Unsupported Intl.${family} option ${name}`);
    }
  }
}

function requireOptionValue(value, allowed, family, name) {
  if (value !== undefined && !allowed.includes(value)) {
    throw new RangeError(`Unsupported Intl.${family} ${name} value ${JSON.stringify(value)}`);
  }
  return value;
}

function offsetTimeZone(value) {
  // ECMA-402 OffsetTimeZoneIdentifier accepts signed two-digit hours with optional minutes.
  const match = /^([+-])(\d{2})(?::?(\d{2}))?$/u.exec(value);
  if (match === null) return undefined;
  const hours = Number(match[2]);
  const minutes = match[3] === undefined ? 0 : Number(match[3]);
  if (hours > 23 || minutes > 59) return undefined;
  const offsetSeconds = (hours * 60 + minutes) * 60;
  return {
    canonical:
      offsetSeconds === 0
        ? "+00:00"
        : `${match[1]}${match[2]}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")}`,
    offsetSeconds: match[1] === "-" ? -offsetSeconds : offsetSeconds,
  };
}

function parseSignedTime(text, description) {
  const match = /^([+-]?)(\d{1,3})(?::(\d{1,2}))?(?::(\d{1,2}))?$/u.exec(text);
  if (match === null) throw new Error(`Invalid pinned timezone ${description}`);
  const sign = match[1] === "-" ? -1 : 1;
  const minutes = match[3] === undefined ? 0 : Number(match[3]);
  const seconds = match[4] === undefined ? 0 : Number(match[4]);
  if (minutes > 59 || seconds > 59) throw new Error(`Invalid pinned timezone ${description}`);
  return sign * (Number(match[2]) * 3600 + minutes * 60 + seconds);
}

function parsePosixName(text, cursor) {
  if (text[cursor] === "<") {
    const end = text.indexOf(">", cursor + 1);
    if (end === -1) throw new Error("Invalid pinned POSIX timezone name");
    return { cursor: end + 1, name: text.slice(cursor + 1, end) };
  }
  const match = /^[A-Za-z]{3,}/u.exec(text.slice(cursor));
  if (match === null) throw new Error("Invalid pinned POSIX timezone name");
  return { cursor: cursor + match[0].length, name: match[0] };
}

function parsePosixOffset(text, cursor, description) {
  const match = /^[+-]?\d{1,3}(?::\d{1,2})?(?::\d{1,2})?/u.exec(text.slice(cursor));
  if (match === null) throw new Error(`Invalid pinned POSIX ${description}`);
  return {
    cursor: cursor + match[0].length,
    offsetSeconds: -parseSignedTime(match[0], description),
  };
}

function parsePosixRule(text) {
  const match = /^M(\d{1,2})\.(\d)\.(\d)(?:\/(.+))?$/u.exec(text);
  if (match === null) throw new Error("Pinned timezone uses an unsupported POSIX transition rule");
  const month = Number(match[1]);
  const week = Number(match[2]);
  const weekday = Number(match[3]);
  if (month < 1 || month > 12 || week < 1 || week > 5 || weekday > 6) {
    throw new Error("Pinned timezone has an invalid POSIX transition rule");
  }
  return {
    month,
    seconds: match[4] === undefined ? 7200 : parseSignedTime(match[4], "transition time"),
    week,
    weekday,
  };
}

function parsePosixFooter(text) {
  if (text.length === 0) return null;
  const standardName = parsePosixName(text, 0);
  const standard = parsePosixOffset(text, standardName.cursor, "standard offset");
  if (standard.cursor === text.length) {
    return Object.freeze({
      daylightOffsetSeconds: null,
      standardOffsetSeconds: standard.offsetSeconds,
    });
  }
  const daylightName = parsePosixName(text, standard.cursor);
  let cursor = daylightName.cursor;
  let daylightOffsetSeconds = standard.offsetSeconds + 3600;
  if (text[cursor] !== ",") {
    const daylight = parsePosixOffset(text, cursor, "daylight offset");
    daylightOffsetSeconds = daylight.offsetSeconds;
    cursor = daylight.cursor;
  }
  if (text[cursor] !== ",") throw new Error("Pinned timezone is missing POSIX transition rules");
  const rules = text.slice(cursor + 1).split(",");
  if (rules.length !== 2) throw new Error("Pinned timezone has invalid POSIX transition rules");
  return Object.freeze({
    daylightOffsetSeconds,
    end: Object.freeze(parsePosixRule(rules[1])),
    standardOffsetSeconds: standard.offsetSeconds,
    start: Object.freeze(parsePosixRule(rules[0])),
  });
}

function transitionUtcSeconds(year, rule, previousOffsetSeconds) {
  const firstWeekday = modulo(daysFromCivil(year, rule.month, 1) + 4, 7);
  let day = 1 + modulo(rule.weekday - firstWeekday, 7) + (rule.week - 1) * 7;
  const maximumDay = daysInMonth(year, rule.month);
  if (day > maximumDay) day -= 7;
  return daysFromCivil(year, rule.month, day) * DAY_SECONDS + rule.seconds - previousOffsetSeconds;
}

function posixOffsetAt(timestampSeconds, footer) {
  if (footer === null || footer.daylightOffsetSeconds === null) {
    return footer === null ? undefined : footer.standardOffsetSeconds;
  }
  const approximateLocalDays = floorDiv(
    timestampSeconds + footer.standardOffsetSeconds,
    DAY_SECONDS
  );
  const year = civilFromDays(approximateLocalDays).year;
  const start = transitionUtcSeconds(year, footer.start, footer.standardOffsetSeconds);
  const end = transitionUtcSeconds(year, footer.end, footer.daylightOffsetSeconds);
  const inDaylight =
    start < end
      ? timestampSeconds >= start && timestampSeconds < end
      : timestampSeconds >= start || timestampSeconds < end;
  return inDaylight ? footer.daylightOffsetSeconds : footer.standardOffsetSeconds;
}

export function createIntl(timeZoneData) {
  if (timeZoneData.kind !== "convex-wasm-iana-tzdata-2026c-v1") {
    throw new Error("Pinned Convex Wasm timezone data kind changed");
  }
  const offsets = Object.freeze(
    timeZoneData.offsets.split("|").map((offset) => Number.parseInt(offset, 36))
  );
  const packedZones = Object.create(null);
  const canonicalByUppercase = Object.create(null);
  for (const packedZone of timeZoneData.zones) {
    const delimiter = packedZone.indexOf("|");
    const name = packedZone.slice(0, delimiter);
    packedZones[name] = packedZone.slice(delimiter + 1);
    canonicalByUppercase[name.toUpperCase()] = name;
  }
  for (const packedAlias of timeZoneData.aliases) {
    const delimiter = packedAlias.indexOf("|");
    const alias = packedAlias.slice(0, delimiter);
    const canonical = packedAlias.slice(delimiter + 1);
    if (packedZones[canonical] === undefined) {
      throw new Error("Pinned timezone alias has no canonical zone");
    }
    canonicalByUppercase[alias.toUpperCase()] = canonical;
  }
  Object.freeze(packedZones);
  Object.freeze(canonicalByUppercase);
  const parsedZoneCache = Object.create(null);

  function canonicalTimeZone(value) {
    const requested = value === undefined ? "UTC" : String(value);
    const offset = offsetTimeZone(requested);
    if (offset !== undefined) return offset.canonical;
    const canonical = canonicalByUppercase[requested.toUpperCase()];
    if (canonical === undefined) {
      throw new RangeError(`Invalid time zone ${JSON.stringify(requested)}`);
    }
    return canonical === "Etc/UTC" || canonical === "Etc/GMT" ? "UTC" : canonical;
  }

  function parseZone(canonical) {
    const dataName = canonical === "UTC" ? "Etc/UTC" : canonical;
    let zone = parsedZoneCache[dataName];
    if (zone !== undefined) return zone;
    const fields = packedZones[dataName].split("|");
    const footerField = fields.pop();
    if (!footerField.startsWith("~")) throw new Error("Pinned timezone footer is missing");
    const periods = fields.map((field) => {
      const delimiter = field.indexOf(",");
      const timestamp = field.slice(0, delimiter);
      const offsetIndex = Number.parseInt(field.slice(delimiter + 1), 36);
      if (offsets[offsetIndex] === undefined) throw new Error("Pinned timezone offset is missing");
      return Object.freeze({
        offsetSeconds: offsets[offsetIndex],
        startSeconds: timestamp === "" ? -Infinity : Number.parseInt(timestamp, 36),
      });
    });
    zone = Object.freeze({
      footer: parsePosixFooter(footerField.slice(1)),
      periods: Object.freeze(periods),
    });
    parsedZoneCache[dataName] = zone;
    return zone;
  }

  function offsetAt(canonical, timestampMs) {
    const fixedOffset = offsetTimeZone(canonical);
    if (fixedOffset !== undefined) return fixedOffset.offsetSeconds;
    const zone = parseZone(canonical);
    const timestampSeconds = timestampMs / 1000;
    const lastPeriod = zone.periods[zone.periods.length - 1];
    if (timestampSeconds > lastPeriod.startSeconds) {
      const footerOffset = posixOffsetAt(timestampSeconds, zone.footer);
      if (footerOffset !== undefined) return footerOffset;
    }
    let low = 0;
    let high = zone.periods.length;
    while (low + 1 < high) {
      const middle = floorDiv(low + high, 2);
      if (zone.periods[middle].startSeconds <= timestampSeconds) low = middle;
      else high = middle;
    }
    return zone.periods[low].offsetSeconds;
  }

  function dateFields(timestampMs, timeZone) {
    const localMs = timestampMs + offsetAt(timeZone, timestampMs) * 1000;
    const days = floorDiv(localMs, DAY_MS);
    const withinDayMs = localMs - days * DAY_MS;
    const civil = civilFromDays(days);
    return {
      day: civil.day,
      hour: floorDiv(withinDayMs, 3600000),
      minute: floorDiv(withinDayMs % 3600000, 60000),
      month: civil.month,
      second: floorDiv(withinDayMs % 60000, 1000),
      weekday: modulo(days + 4, 7),
      year: civil.year,
    };
  }

  function normalizeDateTimeOptions(locale, rawOptions) {
    const options = optionsObject(rawOptions);
    rejectPresentOptions(
      options,
      [
        "dateStyle",
        "dayPeriod",
        "era",
        "formatMatcher",
        "fractionalSecondDigits",
        "localeMatcher",
        "timeStyle",
        "timeZoneName",
      ],
      "DateTimeFormat"
    );
    const calendar = requireOptionValue(
      options.calendar,
      ["gregory"],
      "DateTimeFormat",
      "calendar"
    );
    const numberingSystem = requireOptionValue(
      options.numberingSystem,
      ["latn"],
      "DateTimeFormat",
      "numberingSystem"
    );
    const components = {
      day: requireOptionValue(options.day, ["numeric", "2-digit"], "DateTimeFormat", "day"),
      hour: requireOptionValue(options.hour, ["numeric", "2-digit"], "DateTimeFormat", "hour"),
      minute: requireOptionValue(
        options.minute,
        ["numeric", "2-digit"],
        "DateTimeFormat",
        "minute"
      ),
      month: requireOptionValue(options.month, ["numeric", "2-digit"], "DateTimeFormat", "month"),
      second: requireOptionValue(
        options.second,
        ["numeric", "2-digit"],
        "DateTimeFormat",
        "second"
      ),
      weekday: requireOptionValue(options.weekday, ["short"], "DateTimeFormat", "weekday"),
      year: requireOptionValue(options.year, ["numeric", "2-digit"], "DateTimeFormat", "year"),
    };
    if (Object.values(components).every((value) => value === undefined)) {
      components.year = "numeric";
      components.month = "numeric";
      components.day = "numeric";
    }
    const requestedHourCycle = requireOptionValue(
      options.hourCycle,
      ["h23"],
      "DateTimeFormat",
      "hourCycle"
    );
    const requestedHour12 = options.hour12;
    if (requestedHour12 !== undefined && Boolean(requestedHour12)) {
      throw new RangeError("Intl.DateTimeFormat hour12=true is unsupported");
    }
    if (
      components.hour !== undefined &&
      requestedHourCycle === undefined &&
      requestedHour12 === undefined
    ) {
      throw new RangeError("Intl.DateTimeFormat hours require hour12=false or hourCycle=h23");
    }
    const completeDate =
      components.year !== undefined &&
      components.month !== undefined &&
      components.day !== undefined;
    if (completeDate && (locale === "en-CA" || locale === "ru-RU")) {
      components.month = "2-digit";
      components.day = "2-digit";
    }
    if (components.hour !== undefined) {
      if (
        locale !== "ru-RU" ||
        components.minute !== undefined ||
        components.second !== undefined
      ) {
        components.hour = "2-digit";
      }
      if (components.minute !== undefined) components.minute = "2-digit";
      if (components.second !== undefined) components.second = "2-digit";
    }
    return {
      calendar: calendar === undefined ? "gregory" : calendar,
      components: Object.freeze(components),
      hour12: components.hour === undefined ? undefined : false,
      hourCycle: components.hour === undefined ? undefined : "h23",
      locale,
      numberingSystem: numberingSystem === undefined ? "latn" : numberingSystem,
      timeZone: canonicalTimeZone(options.timeZone),
    };
  }

  function numberPart(value, style) {
    const text = String(value);
    if (style === "2-digit" && text.length < 2) return `0${text}`;
    return text;
  }

  function dateTimeParts(slots, input) {
    const converted = input === undefined ? Date.now() : Number(input);
    if (!Number.isFinite(converted) || Math.abs(converted) > DATE_LIMIT_MS) {
      throw new RangeError("Invalid time value");
    }
    const timestampMs = Math.trunc(converted);
    const fields = dateFields(timestampMs, slots.timeZone);
    const components = slots.components;
    const parts = [];
    const dateParts = [];
    const timeParts = [];
    const hasCalendarDate =
      components.year !== undefined ||
      components.month !== undefined ||
      components.day !== undefined;
    if (components.weekday !== undefined) {
      parts.push({
        type: "weekday",
        value: (slots.locale === "ru-RU" ? russianWeekdays : englishWeekdays)[fields.weekday],
      });
      if (hasCalendarDate) parts.push({ type: "literal", value: ", " });
      else if (
        components.hour !== undefined ||
        components.minute !== undefined ||
        components.second !== undefined
      ) {
        parts.push({ type: "literal", value: " " });
      }
    }
    const dateOrder =
      slots.locale === "en-CA"
        ? ["year", "month", "day"]
        : slots.locale === "ru-RU"
          ? ["day", "month", "year"]
          : ["month", "day", "year"];
    const dateSeparator = slots.locale === "en-CA" ? "-" : slots.locale === "ru-RU" ? "." : "/";
    for (const name of dateOrder) {
      if (components[name] === undefined) continue;
      if (dateParts.length !== 0) dateParts.push({ type: "literal", value: dateSeparator });
      let value = fields[name];
      if (name === "year") value = value <= 0 ? 1 - value : value;
      let formatted = numberPart(value, components[name]);
      if (name === "year" && components.year === "2-digit") {
        formatted = String(value % 100).padStart(2, "0");
      }
      dateParts.push({ type: name, value: formatted });
    }
    for (const name of ["hour", "minute", "second"]) {
      if (components[name] === undefined) continue;
      if (timeParts.length !== 0) timeParts.push({ type: "literal", value: ":" });
      timeParts.push({ type: name, value: numberPart(fields[name], components[name]) });
    }
    parts.push(...dateParts);
    if (dateParts.length !== 0 && timeParts.length !== 0) {
      parts.push({ type: "literal", value: ", " });
    }
    parts.push(...timeParts);
    return parts;
  }

  function DateTimeFormat(locales, options) {
    if (!(this instanceof DateTimeFormat)) return new DateTimeFormat(locales, options);
    const locale = canonicalLocale(locales);
    dateTimeSlots.set(this, normalizeDateTimeOptions(locale, options));
  }

  Object.defineProperty(DateTimeFormat.prototype, "format", {
    configurable: true,
    get() {
      const slots = dateTimeSlots.get(this);
      if (slots === undefined)
        throw new TypeError("Intl.DateTimeFormat format receiver is invalid");
      if (slots.boundFormat === undefined) {
        Object.defineProperty(slots, "boundFormat", {
          value: (input) =>
            dateTimeParts(slots, input)
              .map((part) => part.value)
              .join(""),
        });
      }
      return slots.boundFormat;
    },
  });
  Object.defineProperty(DateTimeFormat.prototype, "formatToParts", {
    configurable: true,
    value(input) {
      const slots = dateTimeSlots.get(this);
      if (slots === undefined) {
        throw new TypeError("Intl.DateTimeFormat formatToParts receiver is invalid");
      }
      return dateTimeParts(slots, input);
    },
    writable: true,
  });
  Object.defineProperty(DateTimeFormat.prototype, "resolvedOptions", {
    configurable: true,
    value() {
      const slots = dateTimeSlots.get(this);
      if (slots === undefined) {
        throw new TypeError("Intl.DateTimeFormat resolvedOptions receiver is invalid");
      }
      const resolved = {
        locale: slots.locale,
        calendar: slots.calendar,
        numberingSystem: slots.numberingSystem,
        timeZone: slots.timeZone,
      };
      if (slots.hourCycle !== undefined) {
        resolved.hourCycle = slots.hourCycle;
        resolved.hour12 = slots.hour12;
      }
      for (const name of ["weekday", "year", "month", "day", "hour", "minute", "second"]) {
        if (slots.components[name] !== undefined) resolved[name] = slots.components[name];
      }
      return resolved;
    },
    writable: true,
  });

  function normalizeNumberOptions(locale, rawOptions) {
    const options = optionsObject(rawOptions);
    rejectPresentOptions(
      options,
      [
        "compactDisplay",
        "currency",
        "currencyDisplay",
        "currencySign",
        "maximumSignificantDigits",
        "minimumSignificantDigits",
        "roundingIncrement",
        "roundingMode",
        "roundingPriority",
        "scale",
        "signDisplay",
        "trailingZeroDisplay",
        "unit",
        "unitDisplay",
      ],
      "NumberFormat"
    );
    requireOptionValue(options.style, ["decimal"], "NumberFormat", "style");
    requireOptionValue(options.notation, ["standard"], "NumberFormat", "notation");
    requireOptionValue(options.numberingSystem, ["latn"], "NumberFormat", "numberingSystem");
    if (options.minimumIntegerDigits !== undefined && Number(options.minimumIntegerDigits) !== 1) {
      throw new RangeError("Intl.NumberFormat minimumIntegerDigits must be 1");
    }
    if (
      options.useGrouping !== undefined &&
      options.useGrouping !== true &&
      options.useGrouping !== "auto"
    ) {
      throw new RangeError("Intl.NumberFormat useGrouping must remain enabled");
    }
    if (options.maximumFractionDigits === undefined) {
      throw new RangeError("Intl.NumberFormat maximumFractionDigits must be 0 or 2");
    }
    const maximumFractionDigits = Number(options.maximumFractionDigits);
    const minimumFractionDigits =
      options.minimumFractionDigits === undefined ? 0 : Number(options.minimumFractionDigits);
    if (
      ![0, 2].includes(minimumFractionDigits) ||
      ![0, 2].includes(maximumFractionDigits) ||
      minimumFractionDigits > maximumFractionDigits
    ) {
      throw new RangeError("Intl.NumberFormat fraction digits must be 0 or 2 in ascending order");
    }
    return { locale, maximumFractionDigits, minimumFractionDigits };
  }

  function incrementDecimalDigits(digits) {
    const values = digits.split("");
    for (let index = values.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
      if (values[index] !== "9") {
        values[index] = String(Number(values[index]) + 1);
        return values.join("");
      }
      values[index] = "0";
    }
    return `1${values.join("")}`;
  }

  function decimalMagnitude(value) {
    const text = value.toString();
    const exponentIndex = text.indexOf("e");
    const coefficient = exponentIndex === -1 ? text : text.slice(0, exponentIndex);
    const exponent = exponentIndex === -1 ? 0 : Number(text.slice(exponentIndex + 1));
    const decimalIndex = coefficient.indexOf(".");
    return {
      decimalPosition: (decimalIndex === -1 ? coefficient.length : decimalIndex) + exponent,
      digits: coefficient.replace(".", ""),
    };
  }

  function roundedDecimal(value, maximumFractionDigits) {
    const magnitude = decimalMagnitude(value);
    const retainedDigits = magnitude.decimalPosition + maximumFractionDigits;
    let scaled;
    if (retainedDigits < 0) {
      scaled = "0";
    } else if (retainedDigits === 0) {
      scaled = magnitude.digits[0] >= "5" ? "1" : "0";
    } else {
      scaled = magnitude.digits.slice(0, retainedDigits).padEnd(retainedDigits, "0");
      if (magnitude.digits.length > retainedDigits && magnitude.digits[retainedDigits] >= "5") {
        scaled = incrementDecimalDigits(scaled);
      }
    }
    if (maximumFractionDigits === 0) return { fraction: "", integer: scaled };
    const padded = scaled.padStart(maximumFractionDigits + 1, "0");
    return {
      fraction: padded.slice(-maximumFractionDigits),
      integer: padded.slice(0, -maximumFractionDigits),
    };
  }

  function groupInteger(integer, separator) {
    let grouped = "";
    for (let index = 0; index < integer.length; index += 1) {
      if (index !== 0 && (integer.length - index) % 3 === 0) grouped += separator;
      grouped += integer[index];
    }
    return grouped;
  }

  function formatNumber(slots, input) {
    const numeric = typeof input === "bigint" ? input : Number(input);
    const russian = slots.locale === "ru-RU";
    if (typeof numeric === "number") {
      if (Number.isNaN(numeric)) return russian ? "не число" : "NaN";
      if (numeric === Infinity) return "∞";
      if (numeric === -Infinity) return "-∞";
    }
    const negative = numeric < 0 || (numeric === 0 && 1 / numeric === -Infinity);
    const absolute = negative ? -numeric : numeric;
    let decimal;
    if (typeof absolute === "bigint") {
      decimal = { fraction: "0".repeat(slots.maximumFractionDigits), integer: absolute.toString() };
    } else {
      decimal = roundedDecimal(absolute, slots.maximumFractionDigits);
    }
    while (
      decimal.fraction.length > slots.minimumFractionDigits &&
      decimal.fraction.endsWith("0")
    ) {
      decimal.fraction = decimal.fraction.slice(0, -1);
    }
    const grouped = groupInteger(decimal.integer, russian ? " " : ",");
    const fraction =
      decimal.fraction.length === 0 ? "" : `${russian ? "," : "."}${decimal.fraction}`;
    return `${negative ? "-" : ""}${grouped}${fraction}`;
  }

  function NumberFormat(locales, options) {
    if (!(this instanceof NumberFormat)) return new NumberFormat(locales, options);
    const locale = canonicalLocale(locales);
    numberSlots.set(this, normalizeNumberOptions(locale, options));
  }

  Object.defineProperty(NumberFormat.prototype, "format", {
    configurable: true,
    get() {
      const slots = numberSlots.get(this);
      if (slots === undefined) throw new TypeError("Intl.NumberFormat format receiver is invalid");
      if (slots.boundFormat === undefined) {
        Object.defineProperty(slots, "boundFormat", {
          value: (input) => formatNumber(slots, input),
        });
      }
      return slots.boundFormat;
    },
  });
  Object.defineProperty(NumberFormat.prototype, "resolvedOptions", {
    configurable: true,
    value() {
      const slots = numberSlots.get(this);
      if (slots === undefined) {
        throw new TypeError("Intl.NumberFormat resolvedOptions receiver is invalid");
      }
      return {
        locale: slots.locale,
        numberingSystem: "latn",
        style: "decimal",
        minimumIntegerDigits: 1,
        minimumFractionDigits: slots.minimumFractionDigits,
        maximumFractionDigits: slots.maximumFractionDigits,
        useGrouping: "auto",
        notation: "standard",
        signDisplay: "auto",
        roundingIncrement: 1,
        roundingMode: "halfExpand",
        roundingPriority: "auto",
        trailingZeroDisplay: "auto",
      };
    },
    writable: true,
  });

  Object.defineProperty(DateTimeFormat.prototype, Symbol.toStringTag, {
    configurable: true,
    value: "Intl.DateTimeFormat",
  });
  Object.defineProperty(NumberFormat.prototype, Symbol.toStringTag, {
    configurable: true,
    value: "Intl.NumberFormat",
  });
  return { DateTimeFormat, NumberFormat };
}
